principles: Add v2 readers and persistence before removing v1 code.
Preserve all existing lesson, exercise, route, profile and sync identifiers wherever content meaning is unchanged.
Do not infer new mastery from guided-practice scores.
Do not relock a child who already completed legacy content.

modelMapping.strategy: New additive model; generated migration creates one shared acquire stage followed by one or more complete practise/apply/test sections.
Merge explanation and review content into child-facing theory blocks.
Separate guided, fading-support and independent sets.
Classify by intent; only an independent assessment becomes MASTERY_TEST.
Preserve exercise IDs and move definitions from XML to canonical curated catalog.
Preserve generator ID/version and make representation and mastery tags explicit.
Split into one CURATED set and one GENERATED set; no third runtime source type.
Grandfather completion for prerequisite availability; retain a legacy-evidence marker.
Practice remains diagnostic; only AssessmentAttempt affects pass/unlock.
Persist mastery/error tags, recurrence dates and resolution status.
